PLAN "Full 12-Week Beginner Strength Plan with Nutrition, Mobility, Cardio, Saturday Finishers, and Home Setup"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational full-body strength using bodyweight, minimal equipment, and progressive overload; maintain mobility and motivation with enjoyable Saturday finishers"
  GOAL endurance:
    name "Support work capacity and recovery through light cardio and mobility

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper/Push Foundation":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking_in_place 10 minutes
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower/Posterior Foundation":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lying_leg_raise 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          high_knees 5 minutes
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pulling/Core Foundation":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          inverted_bodyweight_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..45 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          jumping_jack 5 minutes
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Saturday finisher 20m "Fun Saturday Finisher":
        warmup:
          light march 2 minutes
        main circuit (repeat 2 rounds):
          1) bear_crawl 20 seconds
          2) crab_walk 20 seconds
          3) squat_shell_to_point 20 seconds
          4) incline_push_up_tap_variant 8 reps
        cooldown:
          full_body stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progress Push":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x9..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking_in_place 12 minutes
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Progress Lower":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12..18 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..18 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lying_leg_raise 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          jog_in_place 6 minutes
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull/Core Progress":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          inverted_bodyweight_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..40 seconds per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          brisk_walk 10 minutes
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper/Push Strength":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dip 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walk_in_place 6 minutes
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Saturday finisher 25m "Saturday Finisher - Phase 2":
        warmup:
          light jog 2 minutes
        main circuit (3 rounds):
          bear_crawl 20 seconds
          lunge_step 12 each leg
          push_up + rotation 6 reps
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Push Intensity Increase":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          dip 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower/Posterior Intensity Alternate":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..18 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull/Core Intensity Finish":
        warmup:
          march 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x15..20 per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Hypertrophy/Strength Blend":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dip 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
        CARDIO_SESSION:
          walking_in_place 10 minutes
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
      DAY Saturday finisher 25m "Saturday Finisher Phase 3":
        warmup:
          light jog 2 minutes
        main circuit (3 rounds):
          bear_crawl 20 seconds
          reverse_lunge 12 per leg
          push_up with rotation 6
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Strength/Stability":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..18 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
        mobility:
          NAME "Daily Mobility Routine" APPLY
      DAY Saturday finisher 25m "Saturday Finisher Phase 3 - 2":
        warmup:
          light jog 2 minutes
        main circuit (3 rounds):
          step_up 12 per leg
          plank_up 6 total
          incline_push_up 8
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3-4:
      Retain structure with continued progression and similar Saturday finisher variants; mobility routine remains daily.

  BRANCH "Phase 1-3 Summary":
    - Weekly structure: 3 main training days (Mon/Wed/Fri) with optional Saturday finisher per phase.
    - Saturday finishers: playful, bodyweight-based circuits to boost engagement without compromising main plan.
    - Mobility: daily 10-minute routine integrated into workouts (and reusable on off days).
    - Cardio: home-friendly options on non-consecutive days or after sessions; RPE targets 5–6/10.
    - Progression: gradual increases in reps first, then sets, with occasional RPE bumps for Phase 2 push intensity and Phase 3 hypertrophy emphasis.
    - Equipment: designed for minimal equipment (yoga mat, doorway pull-up bar); substitutions provided (inverted rows, incline variations) if needed.

NUTRITION
  NUTRITIONAL_PLAN
    CALORIE_TARGET "Maintenance with optional 5–10% training-day surplus for muscle gain"
    MACROS
      PROTEIN_G_PER_KG 1.6
      CARBS_G_PER_KG 3.0
      FATS_G_PER_KG 0.8
    PROTEIN_TIMING "0.25–0.4 g/kg per meal across 3–4 meals daily"
    MEAL_STRUCTURE
      BREAKFAST "Protein + complex carbs + healthy fats"
      LUNCH "Protein + carbs + vegetables"
      DINNER "Protein + vegetables + moderate carbs if energy needed"
      SNACKS "Protein-rich options, fruit"
    FLUID_INTake "2.2–3.0 liters per day"
    SUPPLEMENT_GUIDANCE
      CREAPE "Creatine monohydrate 3–5 g daily"
      WHEY "Optional: 20–30 g post-workout if protein intake is insufficient"
      VITAMIN_D "Baseline vitamin D3 1000–2000 IU if deficient or limited sun"
    FASTING "Not recommended during initial 12 weeks for strength gains"
    NOTES
      - Reassess calories every 2–4 weeks based on progress
      - Prioritize whole foods; hydrate and sleep 7–9 hours

CARDIO
  HOME_CARDIO
    MODALITIES
      - walking_in_place
      - jog_in_place
      - jumping_jack
      - high_knees
      - stair_climb
    GUIDANCE
      - Use 2–3 modalities on non-consecutive days or after workouts
      - If space is tight, 10–20 minute brisk circuits
      - RPE target 5–6/10
      - Progression: +2–5 minutes weekly or add a circuit
    SAFETY
      - Clear area; use mat
      - Low-impact options if needed
      - Avoid jumping if joints sensitive

MOBILITY
  ROUTINE
    NAME "Daily Mobility Routine"
    FREQUENCY "Daily" 
    DURATION "10 minutes" 
    ROUTINES
      - a1: "Upper Body Shoulder/Thoracic"
        STEPS
          - "Cat-Cow 1 minute"
          - "Thread the Needle 1 minute per side"
          - "Doorway Lat Stretch 1 minute per side" 
          - "Thoracic Openers (foam roller-style) 1 minute"
      - a2: "Hips/Glutes"
        STEPS
          - "Hip Circles 1 minute"
          - "80/20 Hip Flexor Stretch 1 minute per side"
          - "Pigeon Pose (gentle) 1 minute per side"
          - "90/90 Transitional Mobility 1 minute per side"
      - a3: " Ankles/Calves"
        STEPS
          - "Ankle Circles 1 minute per direction"
          - "Calf Stretch against wall 1 minute per leg"
      - a4: "Spine/Core Mobility"
        STEPS
          - "Child Pose to Cobra flow 2 rounds x 30 seconds"
          - "Spinal Twist Seated 1 minute per side"
          - "Pelvic Tilts 1 minute"
    NOTES
      - Perform in warmup or post-workout, or as a standalone brief session on off days.
      - Breathe deep, move within a comfortable range, avoid pain.

SYNTAX RULES
- Rep ranges use two dots. Example: 4x8..12 rpe 7.
- Sets always first; e.g., 4x8.
- RPE after sets/reps.
- Rest in seconds as specified.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY
- push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES
- running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

NOTES
- All phases stay aligned with the original program structure; Saturdays remain optional finisher days.
- Finishers and mobility are integrated to support recovery and engagement in a small space.
- If any exercise or routine conflicts with client constraints, substitutions are provided within allowed vocabulary.
